patch.value: Linked-test regular-file capture still aborts high-volume Vitest output with UNKNOWN synchronous write failure

Running the repository-wide coverage command directly passes 7,443 tests at exact 100/100/100/100, but recording and executing the identical command through pm test --run --only-index 4 aborts around 200 seconds after retained child output reaches the linked-test reporting boundary. Node raises Error: UNKNOWN: unknown error, write from SyncWriteStream._write while Vitest reports progress; coverage-summary.json is then absent and pm classifies the product-independent transport failure as assertion_failure. The earlier EAGAIN regressions were fixed with regular-file capture, so this is a distinct released-version recurrence at the reporter-to-parent output boundary.

A linked test whose child emits repository-coverage-scale output completes without EAGAIN, UNKNOWN write, broken pipe, or missing coverage artifact; Retained output remains bounded and exposes a truncation receipt without aborting the child or parent reporter; Infrastructure output-capture failures are classified separately from assertion failures
pm test can execute the same verbose coverage command that passes directly and persist a bounded successful test-run receipt.
Direct execution passed 7,443 tests at exact 100/100/100/100; linked execution failed after about 201 seconds with Node UNKNOWN write and no coverage-summary.json.
